# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup experiences false entries on days when VIX is low or falling, leading to losses on J loser days (5/05, 5/06, 5/07). By tightening the existing VIX confirmation rule to require VIX > 20 AND rising (instead of OR), we aim to filter out low-VIX breakdowns that fail to follow through, preserving winners while reducing loser-day losses.

## Mechanism

Add a pre-entry filter in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup logic: only allow entry if (current VIX > 20.0) AND (current VIX > VIX_5min_ago). This replaces the existing OR condition with an AND. The filter evaluates on the entry trigger bar using real-time VIX data (same source as playbook). All other context filters, trigger conditions, entry/exit rules remain unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L due to 50% risk cap and $0.50–$2.00 entry premium range.
2. **Sample bias:** Using J's 6 anchor days (3 winners, 3 losers) as proxy; high overfit risk due to small sample. Will test on 16-month OOS window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward to mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run grinder harness Stage-1 walk-forward on full dataset post-signal frequency check).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate top 3 J days via realistic OPRA sim post-grinder).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 VIX spike (>30) may still trigger but could whipsaw if reversal intraday.
   - Max drawdown: Potential missing winners if VIX >20 but not rising (e.g., VIX flat >20).
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent low-VIX regime (VIX<15) causing zero trades and opportunity cost.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days currently contribute ~180% of P&L (based on leaderboard notes); this filter may reduce concentration by blocking low-VIX chop days.

## Pre-merge gate

- Grinder harness Stage-1: signal frequency >0.5/day, edge_capture >771 on J anchors, walk-forward Sharpe >0.7.
- Real-fills validation on 4/29, 5/01, 5/04: diff <±20% vs BS-sim.
- Regime robustness: positive edge in VIX<15, 15-20, >20 regimes (walk-forward split).

6 / 10 -- Based on playbook VIX logic already showing VIX_MODERATE (15-20) as optimal for bearish setups (per V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE watcher analysis). Requires empirical validation to confirm AND condition improves over OR.
